thread:
Omar S: FYI - Silverpine just sent an RFI. They want a capability matrix, completed security questionnaire, and a 2-week POC plan that demonstrates HSM support + regional data residency. Deadline EOD tomorrow. Drive: https://drive.redwood.example/silverpine/rfi
Nina T: Can we do the POC on Dedicated? They want predictable latency and isolation. Also asking about SLA for pilot.
Ben R: Dedicated is fine. Recommend we propose 2 x vGPUs, pre-warmed, routed through a single region (eu-central). Will need PO for reservation.
Lina G: Security questions flagged: HSM backing for keys, SOC2 evidence, encryption in transit at rest, key rotation cadence, and whether logs can be forwarded to their SIEM. I have a one-pager we can reuse.
Chris M: infra-bot notes: reservation possible but must be requested 24h before start. If they want HSM in Private, that requires on-prem or VPC peering + PKCS#11 config. For hosted Dedicated we can support CMEK, not external HSM.
infra-bot: Reservation check: two A10-equivalent hosts available in eu-central from 2026-04-05 for 14 days pending PO.
Nina T: Pricing call: propose 2 flavors: (A) Dedicated pilot: flat $10k/week + $0.0005/token overage. (B) Hosted trial: 30-day capped trial (500k tokens) then standard hosted rates. Ill draft both.
Ben R: Add capability matrix row: "HSM-backed keys (Private only)" - state clearly that hosted Dedicated supports CMEK but not external HSM. Also add row for "regional inference nodes" and "log export to SIEM".
Lina G: Snippet for RFI: ``HSM: Supported for Private/on-prem deployments via PKCS#11 integration. Hosted Dedicated supports customer-managed KMS (CMEK). SOC2 Type II report (2024) available under NDA. Logs: audit and usage logs can be exported to customer S3/GCS or pushed to customer SIEM via webhook/forwarder.``
Omar S: Good. Action items: Ben - update matrix and mark HSM row "Private only"; Nina - upload pricing options and mark them provisional; Lina - attach one-pager + SOC2 excerpt (NDA); Chris - confirm node reservation & monitoring hooks. I'll draft outbound email to Silverpine and loop Legal for NDA. Target to send by 09:00 tomorrow. Keep replies short. :rocket:
